gloss: to threaten; to intimidate; to menace

definitions.gloss: to threaten; to intimidate; to menace; to coerce
definitions.explanation: To use threats of harm or negative consequences to frighten someone or force them into compliance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{脅|おど}して⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{脅|おど}した。
examples.english: He threatened the store clerk with a knife.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ばらす→ばらす：11114_barasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{脅|おど}されて、⟦{仕方|しかた}なく→仕方ない：11434_shikatanai⟧⟦{従|したが}った→従う：02059_shitagau⟧。
examples.english: Threatened with having a secret exposed, I had no choice but to comply.

notes:
A godan verb conjugating with the す row ({脅|おど}す → {脅|おど}して → {脅|おど}した). This is the more colloquial word for threatening, compared to the formal ⟦{脅迫|きょうはく}→脅迫：27205_kyouhaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧Y⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{脅|おど}す

ASPECT (ている):
- Type: Atelic (ongoing action)
- {脅|おど}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = is threatening / is in the process of threatening

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{脅|おど}す: to threaten X (the person being threatened)
- X⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{脅|おど}す: to threaten with X (the weapon or means used)
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{脅|おど}す: to threaten that... (content of the threat)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{脅|おど}す: to threaten with a knife
- ⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}せ→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{脅|おど}す: to threaten someone to hand over money
- ⟦{殺|ころ}す→殺す：01944_korosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{脅|おど}す: to threaten to kill
- {脅|おど}して⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧: to take money by intimidation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脅|おびや}かす→脅かす：13942_obiyakasu⟧: to threaten; to endanger — focuses more on creating a sense of danger or insecurity; more literary
- ⟦{脅迫|きょうはく}→脅迫：27205_kyouhaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to threaten; to coerce — the formal/legal term for making threats
- ⟦{威嚇|いかく}→威嚇：09164_ikaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to intimidate; to menace — emphasizes a display of power to frighten
- ⟦{恐喝|きょうかつ}→恐喝：27210_kyoukatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to blackmail; to extort — specifically involves demanding money through threats
